title: Louis Braille and a System Made by a Teenager
short_teaser: Louis Braille developed his reading system as a teenager after finding existing raised-letter methods too slow.
story: Louis Braille developed his reading system as a teenager after finding existing raised-letter methods too slow. People closest to a problem may see possibilities established experts miss. A life story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
